description: This file is a shell script containing tests for a wildmatch pattern matching library, including various test cases for pattern matching features, path handling, and performance checks.

methods.name: should_create_test_file
methods.description: Determines if a test file should be created based on its filename to avoid filesystem restrictions.

methods.name: match_with_function
methods.description: Runs a match test with a specified matching function (e.g., wildmatch) and verifies whether the pattern and text match as expected.

methods.name: match_with_ls_files
methods.description: Runs matching tests via 'git ls-files' to verify pattern matching behavior in repository file listings.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs comprehensive pattern equality tests across different matching modes and case sensitivities, setting up test files and verifying pattern matches.
